group: Non‑object JsonNode – schema node must be an object

group: Unsupported $schema identifier – version flag not recognised

cases.description: When the schema JSON contains a $schema value that does not map to any known JsonMetaSchema, doCreate should raise IllegalArgumentException indicating an unsupported schema version.

group: Circular schema reference – detection triggers IllegalStateException

cases.description: If the supplied schema (or its $ref chain) creates a circular reference, doCreate is expected to detect it and throw IllegalStateException.
